positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "It's been a little over a year since the Supreme Court ripped away women's reproductive rights. I will not quit until we have codified Roe and guaranteed the right to an abortion for all Americans."

"With the overturning of Roe, women now have fewer rights than they did 50 years ago. That's why I voted for multiple bills in 2022 to protect abortion and contraception. Despite the Senate's inaction, I'm heading into the new Congress determined to protect reproductive rights."
